title: The rationalization
statement:
Let $\mathcal T$ be a triangulated category that is linear over a commutative ring $R$,
with $R$-linear shift functors, and let $M\subseteq R$ be a submonoid. The
*rationalization* $\mathcal T[M^{-1}]$ is the localization of $\mathcal T$ at the class
$W_M$ of [def-sfb-rationalization-morphisms], i.e. the Verdier quotient of $\mathcal T$ by
the triangulated subcategory of $M$-torsion objects [lem-sfb-torsion-triangulated]. It is
a triangulated category, and the localization functor
$Q\colon\mathcal T\to\mathcal T[M^{-1}]$ is triangulated.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: put P equal to the M-torsion object property of lem-sfb-torsion-triangulated and W = P.trW, exactly the distinguished-triangle cone class of def-sfb-rationalization-morphisms (ObjectProperty.trW, Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Triangulated/Subcategory.lean:463–469). Define the rationalization to be W.Localization and Q to be W.Q (CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.Localization and CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.Q, Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Localization/Construction.lean:107–117); this is the Verdier quotient by definition. Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Triangulated/Subcategory.lean:603–619 provides instHasLeftCalculusOfFractionsTrWOfIsTriangulatedOfIsTriangulated, and :644–652 provides the IsCompatibleWithTriangulation instance, from IsTriangulated C and P.IsTriangulated. Hence instance synthesis supplies the prerequisites for instPretriangulatedLocalization at Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Localization/Triangulated.lean:229 and instIsTriangulatedLocalization at :231. For Q, isTriangulated_functor at :208–211 specializes to L = W.Q. R-linear shifts are additive, as required; all other source category assumptions are part of its triangulated structure. No extra hypothesis or comparison theorem is needed.
